facts.evidence: Public product content and samples describe multi-color bases and printing, conductive pills, laser etching, plastic / metal overmolding and several finish examples.

facts.evidence: The page contains construction, conductive design, assembly, printing, special construction, life-test, force/stroke, tolerance and key-section reference images.

facts.evidence: The public site names telecom, security, medical, machinery, home appliance and related application areas.
